title: Reference-to-film example: set your authorized budget before running

image.prompt: Portrait reference of an original fictional adult explorer in a yellow raincoat, short dark hair, green backpack, plain neutral background, natural lighting.

shots.prompt: The explorer from the reference image walks slowly toward a quiet lakeshore at sunrise. Preserve their face, yellow raincoat and green backpack. Wide establishing shot with a gentle tracking camera.
The same explorer from the reference image pauses beside the lake and looks at a small wooden boat. Preserve their face, yellow raincoat and green backpack. Medium shot, gentle morning light.
